description: The bar chart visually compares the performance ratios (as percentages) of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, as presented in the paper “How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception.” The horizontal axis (X-axis) categorizes the domains in the order Movies, Songs, and Basketball, while the vertical axis (Y-axis) quantifies the ratio in percentage, scaled from 50% to 90% with major tick marks at 10% intervals. In the Movies category, both Llama3 and Qwen2 outperform ChatGPT, with Llama3 reaching approximately 90% and Qwen2 slightly higher at around 91%, while ChatGPT lags at roughly 73%. In the Songs category, Llama3 maintains a strong performance at approximately 84%, Qwen2 follows closely at about 90%, and ChatGPT drops significantly to around 62%. In the Basketball category, ChatGPT leads with approximately 62%, followed by Llama3 at 67% and Qwen2 at 58%. The legend positioned at the top center clearly maps each model to its corresponding bar color, enabling direct visual comparison across categories. Notably, the chart reveals that no single model consistently dominates all domains: Llama3 excels in Movies and Songs, Qwen2 peaks in Songs, and ChatGPT performs best in Basketball, suggesting domain-specific strengths influenced by knowledge popularity or training data distribution.

The X-axis contains the categories labeled as Movies, Songs, and Basketball, while the Y-axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90%, with tick intervals of 10%. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 consistently exceeded ChatGPT, with Llama3 reaching approximately 95% and Qwen2 slightly below at 92%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 demonstrated a significant decline compared to Llama3, with Qwen2 at approximately 75% and Llama3 at 90%. In the Basketball category, ChatGPT showed the highest ratio at approximately 70%, followed by Llama3 at 65% and Qwen2 at 60%. The legend at the top center identifies the models corresponding to each bar color: blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, and yellow for ChatGPT.
